components.purpose: One-line notice about the new release at the very top of the page. It is a thin site-wide message bar, and its agent guidance fits a time-boxed launch notice.
Full-width opening banner with a heading, description and two buttons. It renders under the menu when placed at the top, and its agent guidance covers two CTAs over a gradient or background image.
Row of customer logos as social proof, placed directly after the opening banner.
Final 'Get started' call-to-action band with heading, description and buttons, placed at the bottom of the page.
